verdict.rationale: Plaid IDV exposes some machine-consumable outcome signals. Subscribable STATUS_UPDATED and STEP_UPDATED webhooks and Link onEvent/onSuccess callbacks let an automated flow react to session status and step changes. However, the granular risk assessments, overall risk score and largest risk factors are documented only as Dashboard displays, and the failure-reason guidance is human-facing (including a Dashboard override), so there is no evidence these reach an agent as structured API fields. Missing for 10: documented API response schema with per-check results, machine-readable risk scores and signals via API, structured failure reason codes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, verification outcomes come back structured enough for an agent to decide on — machine-readable check results, risk signals, and failure reasons an automated onboarding flow can branch on

citations.quote: You can select which events you want to subscribe to. For Identity Verification, there are three events: STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED
onEvent will fire at certain points throughout the IDV flow with updates on the user's progress at each point.
Identity Verification will also display a set of granular risk assessments (email risk, phone risk, etc.) in the Dashboard for each session, along with an overall risk score
